content: 纯剧情2

raw: [name="Black Market Merchant"]  Hey, come check this out. We got ourselves a new lackey! You, stop lazing around. Go!
speaker: Black Market Merchant
content: Hey, come check this out. We got ourselves a new lackey! You, stop lazing around. Go!

raw: [name="Elliot"]  I'm the new craftsman apprentice. My name's El—
speaker: Elliot
content: I'm the new craftsman apprentice. My name's El—

raw: [name="Black Market Merchant"]  Alright, enough talk. Get moving!
speaker: Black Market Merchant
content: Alright, enough talk. Get moving!

raw: [name="Black Market Merchant"]  Hey, you lot! Use him however you want. He's apparently one of those bookworm types from Columbia, even younger than your kids!
speaker: Black Market Merchant
content: Hey, you lot! Use him however you want. He's apparently one of those bookworm types from Columbia, even younger than your kids!

raw: [name="Black Market Merchant"]  Just treat him like those slaves that got sold to us. As long as it doesn't kill him, that is. It's not like he's got a guardian angel watching his back.
speaker: Black Market Merchant
content: Just treat him like those slaves that got sold to us. As long as it doesn't kill him, that is. It's not like he's got a guardian angel watching his back.

raw: [name="Black Market Merchant"]  We'll work you to bone, kid.
speaker: Black Market Merchant
content: We'll work you to bone, kid.

speaker: Elliot
content: Alright...

speaker: Elliot
content: Isin, look!

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Oh... What a surprise. Did you weld this together with the steel you stole? What a magnificent piece.
speaker: Old Isin
content: Oh... What a surprise. Did you weld this together with the steel you stole? What a magnificent piece.

raw: [name="Elliot"]  You're exaggerating. It doesn't matter how pretty it is; it's just consumables.
speaker: Elliot
content: You're exaggerating. It doesn't matter how pretty it is; it's just consumables.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  But you must rest. Your broken arm has only just healed...
speaker: Old Isin
content: But you must rest. Your broken arm has only just healed...

speaker: Elliot
content: Don't worry.

raw: [name="Elliot"]  Do you know where we can get some refined Originium?
speaker: Elliot
content: Do you know where we can get some refined Originium?

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  There is nothing that gold cannot buy in the Reefsteep Black Market.
speaker: Old Isin
content: There is nothing that gold cannot buy in the Reefsteep Black Market.

raw: [name="Elliot"]  Let's see how this turns out, then...
speaker: Elliot
content: Let's see how this turns out, then...

speaker: Elliot
content: The black scorpion is dead...

speaker: Elliot
content: We've done well, haven't we?

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Old Isin heard from the fence today... The 'Sand Soldier' is the next ruler of Reefsteep.
speaker: Old Isin
content: Old Isin heard from the fence today... The 'Sand Soldier' is the next ruler of Reefsteep.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Do you think you are? Elliot?
speaker: Old Isin
content: Do you think you are? Elliot?

raw: [name="Elliot"]  And do you wish me to be, Isin?
speaker: Elliot
content: And do you wish me to be, Isin?

raw: [name="Elliot"]  I'm not one to forget the kindness others have shown me. If it wasn't for you, I would not have survived these past two decades.
speaker: Elliot
content: I'm not one to forget the kindness others have shown me. If it wasn't for you, I would not have survived these past two decades.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Now you need Old Isin no more...
speaker: Old Isin
content: Now you need Old Isin no more...

raw: [name="Elliot"]  No... Hardly. We have a special relationship, after all.
speaker: Elliot
content: No... Hardly. We have a special relationship, after all.

raw: [name="Elliot"]  But if you wanted to complain, perhaps you should complain to that lady who cloaked herself in all those mysteries.
speaker: Elliot
content: But if you wanted to complain, perhaps you should complain to that lady who cloaked herself in all those mysteries.

speaker: Old Isin
content: Kal'tsit...

raw: [name="Elliot"]  You still remember her name. You've gotten less and less clear-headed over the years. I thought you'd have forgotten that, among many other things.
speaker: Elliot
content: You still remember her name. You've gotten less and less clear-headed over the years. I thought you'd have forgotten that, among many other things.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Have you looked for her?
speaker: Old Isin
content: Have you looked for her?

raw: [name="Elliot"]  Yes, I have, but my attempts have been futile. Not even my most elite intelligence agents could find any information about her in Columbia. Besides, the PMC disbanded not long after that.
speaker: Elliot
content: Yes, I have, but my attempts have been futile. Not even my most elite intelligence agents could find any information about her in Columbia. Besides, the PMC disbanded not long after that.

raw: [name="Elliot"]  The laboratory was taken over by the military, and all of their data were destroyed. I could not find even a single participant... Columbia hid them well.
speaker: Elliot
content: The laboratory was taken over by the military, and all of their data were destroyed. I could not find even a single participant... Columbia hid them well.

raw: [name="'Sand Soldier'"]  The Ibuti Lord Ameer will pass through Redhorn next week. Hoh, fate can be a fickle mistress sometimes.
speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: The Ibuti Lord Ameer will pass through Redhorn next week. Hoh, fate can be a fickle mistress sometimes.

raw: [name="'Sand Soldier'"]  This is an excellent opportunity—Old Isin, are you asleep?
speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: This is an excellent opportunity—Old Isin, are you asleep?

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Old Isin had a dream...
speaker: Old Isin
content: Old Isin had a dream...

raw: [name="'Sand Soldier'"]  Another one of your dreams?
speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: Another one of your dreams?

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  It was still the same dream as always... The Kheshig's footsteps went across the tundra and grasslands, at last reaching the land of golden sands.
speaker: Old Isin
content: It was still the same dream as always... The Kheshig's footsteps went across the tundra and grasslands, at last reaching the land of golden sands.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  But, this time, the dream was a little different...
speaker: Old Isin
content: But, this time, the dream was a little different...

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  It was a scenery that the padishah never recounted to Old Isin... There was someone there... She looked like... like Kal'tsit... in another form.
speaker: Old Isin
content: It was a scenery that the padishah never recounted to Old Isin... There was someone there... She looked like... like Kal'tsit... in another form.

speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: Hm.

speaker: Old Isin
content: She was there.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  When the Kheshigs' conquest shattered that bygone era all those thousands of years ago... she was there...
speaker: Old Isin
content: When the Kheshigs' conquest shattered that bygone era all those thousands of years ago... she was there...

raw: [name="'Sand Soldier'"]  Dreams can't explain much, and there are no Arts that allow us to glimpse into our fate across time. You said so yourself.
speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: Dreams can't explain much, and there are no Arts that allow us to glimpse into our fate across time. You said so yourself.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Yes... This is merely a dream that Old Isin had... a meaningless dream... Lady Kal'tsit could not have had anything to do with them... but it does make Old Isin wonder if there is meaning to this dream.
speaker: Old Isin
content: Yes... This is merely a dream that Old Isin had... a meaningless dream... Lady Kal'tsit could not have had anything to do with them... but it does make Old Isin wonder if there is meaning to this dream.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  At the very end, Old Isin saw the padishah.
speaker: Old Isin
content: At the very end, Old Isin saw the padishah.

raw: [name="'Sand Soldier'"]  Oh? And what did your master tell you this time, old faithful?
speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: Oh? And what did your master tell you this time, old faithful?

speaker: Old Isin
content: He...

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  In my dream... he told Old Isin... where Sargon is...
speaker: Old Isin
content: In my dream... he told Old Isin... where Sargon is...

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  You are planning to ambush the lord ameer's squadron.
speaker: Old Isin
content: You are planning to ambush the lord ameer's squadron.

speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: Yes.

raw: [name="'Sand Soldier'"]  So you mean to tell me that you, a former faithful aide to a Sargon noble, will stop me from disrespecting a lord ameer so?
speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: So you mean to tell me that you, a former faithful aide to a Sargon noble, will stop me from disrespecting a lord ameer so?

speaker: Old Isin
content: —Disrespect?

speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: Hm.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  They are rotten and incompetent. They only know to bootlessly harm their kin and drag innocent Sargonians into war...
speaker: Old Isin
content: They are rotten and incompetent. They only know to bootlessly harm their kin and drag innocent Sargonians into war...

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  They stand on Reefsteep's land, doing their dirty work. Why would Old Isin feel respect for men like them?
speaker: Old Isin
content: They stand on Reefsteep's land, doing their dirty work. Why would Old Isin feel respect for men like them?

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.5, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]
[name="Old Isin"]  Old Isin wants them to pay the price. Old Isin wants the glory of Sargon's past be restored, and not by these good-for-nothing clowns!
speaker: Old Isin
content: Old Isin wants them to pay the price. Old Isin wants the glory of Sargon's past be restored, and not by these good-for-nothing clowns!

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Old Isin... Right... Old Isin must seek the city of golden sands!
speaker: Old Isin
content: Old Isin... Right... Old Isin must seek the city of golden sands!

raw: [name="'Sand Soldier'"]  I don't see you get this excited often. Please, calm down—
speaker: 'Sand Soldier'
content: I don't see you get this excited often. Please, calm down—

speaker: Old Isin
content: It's time...

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Go, my child. Light a fire, and complete your revenge.
speaker: Old Isin
content: Go, my child. Light a fire, and complete your revenge.

raw: [name="Old Isin"]  Until the time comes when the winds finally calm and the eternal city rises from the sandstorm... Old Isin will wait... and Old Isin will reach that place...
speaker: Old Isin
content: Until the time comes when the winds finally calm and the eternal city rises from the sandstorm... Old Isin will wait... and Old Isin will reach that place...

speaker: Sesa
content: This is the place...

speaker: Passenger
content: Very well.

speaker: Sesa
content: Be sure to knock first.

raw: [name="Sesa"]  Don't get any funny ideas. The elite operators here ain't no pushovers.
speaker: Sesa
content: Don't get any funny ideas. The elite operators here ain't no pushovers.

speaker: Sesa
content: Now go.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Looks like that gold coin made it to you.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Looks like that gold coin made it to you.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: How is Old Isin?

raw: [name="Passenger"]  He's lost to the golden sands... It happened one moonlit night three years ago.
speaker: Passenger
content: He's lost to the golden sands... It happened one moonlit night three years ago.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Time. Time can put to rest even a Savra like him. I almost thought him to be one of the ancient, elder beings in folk tales and conspiracy theories.
speaker: Passenger
content: Time. Time can put to rest even a Savra like him. I almost thought him to be one of the ancient, elder beings in folk tales and conspiracy theories.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Time has warped me so much, transforming me into a man my past self would have hated.
speaker: Passenger
content: Time has warped me so much, transforming me into a man my past self would have hated.

speaker: Passenger
content: And you, Kal'tsit?

raw: [name="Passenger"]  It looks like... nothing about you has changed.
speaker: Passenger
content: It looks like... nothing about you has changed.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Are you still the 'Sand Soldier?'

raw: [name="Passenger"]  I already said this when I came onboard. That is all in the past. I have a new name now.
speaker: Passenger
content: I already said this when I came onboard. That is all in the past. I have a new name now.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  You can fool yourself... but you can't fool me.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You can fool yourself... but you can't fool me.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Perhaps. You've always thought everything you said was absolute, and unfortunately for me, you were quite often right.
speaker: Passenger
content: Perhaps. You've always thought everything you said was absolute, and unfortunately for me, you were quite often right.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  You have always had a good memory, Elliot.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You have always had a good memory, Elliot.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Don't call me by that name... Don't we have these codenames exactly for this purpose, to shroud our secrets?
speaker: Passenger
content: Don't call me by that name... Don't we have these codenames exactly for this purpose, to shroud our secrets?

raw: [name="Folinic"]  Dr. Kal'tsit—Oh, my apologies. Do you have a visitor?
speaker: Folinic
content: Dr. Kal'tsit—Oh, my apologies. Do you have a visitor?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No matter.

speaker: Passenger
content: Please, as you were.

raw: [CameraShake(duration=0.3, xstrength=15, ystrength=15, vibrato=20, randomness=70, fadeout=true, block=false)]

speaker: Folinic
content: Okay...

raw: [name="Folinic"]  A Messenger from the field office in Victoria sent us a package. It's pretty strange, too. It's not addressed to Rhodes Island, but you personally. Logistics has already scanned the package. There's an information storage device inside.
speaker: Folinic
content: A Messenger from the field office in Victoria sent us a package. It's pretty strange, too. It's not addressed to Rhodes Island, but you personally. Logistics has already scanned the package. There's an information storage device inside.

raw: [name="Folinic"]  The sender's name is... Heidi Thomson. Do you know her?
speaker: Folinic
content: The sender's name is... Heidi Thomson. Do you know her?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  This is just some intel I needed. Leave it there.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: This is just some intel I needed. Leave it there.

speaker: Folinic
content: Okay... that is all.

speaker: Passenger
content: A new conspiracy, I presume?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Watch your mouth. You may not officially be an operator here yet, but you signed a contract.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Watch your mouth. You may not officially be an operator here yet, but you signed a contract.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Exactly what I expected our 'Operations Adviser' to say.
speaker: Passenger
content: Exactly what I expected our 'Operations Adviser' to say.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Kal'tsit, you pointed Old Isin to a new direction, and for that he was forever grateful up until the moment he set out on his journey again.
speaker: Passenger
content: Kal'tsit, you pointed Old Isin to a new direction, and for that he was forever grateful up until the moment he set out on his journey again.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  I cannot begin to imagine the glory you two shared, but now that my business in Sargon has been taken care of, there is nothing that binds me to this world anymore...
speaker: Passenger
content: I cannot begin to imagine the glory you two shared, but now that my business in Sargon has been taken care of, there is nothing that binds me to this world anymore...

raw: [name="Passenger"]  I suppose you will point me in a new direction as well?
speaker: Passenger
content: I suppose you will point me in a new direction as well?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Before that... Let me introduce you to someone.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Before that... Let me introduce you to someone.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Here I thought you would keep me close to you. Did you get me a partner?
speaker: Passenger
content: Here I thought you would keep me close to you. Did you get me a partner?

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: No.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Your commanding officer.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  A Rhodes Island commander? You... Hoh... There is someone whom you trust so deeply here? I look forward to meeting this person, then.
speaker: Passenger
content: A Rhodes Island commander? You... Hoh... There is someone whom you trust so deeply here? I look forward to meeting this person, then.

speaker: Passenger
content: Kal'tsit...

raw: [name="Passenger"]  You wandered the world for so long. How long will you stay here this time?
speaker: Passenger
content: You wandered the world for so long. How long will you stay here this time?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  You have no right to ask.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You have no right to ask.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Very well, of course. You needn't answer if you don't want to, as you are now my superior.
speaker: Passenger
content: Very well, of course. You needn't answer if you don't want to, as you are now my superior.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  But if this is yet another false identity, and this place where you belong is yet again false, then I am afraid it would hardly be meaningful for me to serve this place.
speaker: Passenger
content: But if this is yet another false identity, and this place where you belong is yet again false, then I am afraid it would hardly be meaningful for me to serve this place.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  How am I to tell you are not using me yet again?
speaker: Passenger
content: How am I to tell you are not using me yet again?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  You have the right to be suspicious...
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: You have the right to be suspicious...

raw: [name="Passenger"]  I need only a little assurance. Will this 'Kal'tsit' who invited me here disappear all of a sudden in a few days, a few months, or perhaps a few years?
speaker: Passenger
content: I need only a little assurance. Will this 'Kal'tsit' who invited me here disappear all of a sudden in a few days, a few months, or perhaps a few years?

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Will she again set off on a journey to take care of some business that a bystander could never come to understand, to drift the world for her own purposes?
speaker: Passenger
content: Will she again set off on a journey to take care of some business that a bystander could never come to understand, to drift the world for her own purposes?

speaker: Passenger
content: Will you?

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  If a simple answer can affect your loyalty to Rhodes Island, then perhaps I must reevaluate this working relationship of ours.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If a simple answer can affect your loyalty to Rhodes Island, then perhaps I must reevaluate this working relationship of ours.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  I only need an answer. An answer should not be so hard for you. I'll even accept a lie.
speaker: Passenger
content: I only need an answer. An answer should not be so hard for you. I'll even accept a lie.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  If it is answers that you want, I have thousands of them.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If it is answers that you want, I have thousands of them.

raw: [name="Passenger"]  Then, please, pick any one of them.
speaker: Passenger
content: Then, please, pick any one of them.

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I—

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Dr. {@nickname}, here you are.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Closure has finished resupplying, but there seems to be an emergency there that needs your attention. Amiya is heading there already.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Closure has finished resupplying, but there seems to be an emergency there that needs your attention. Amiya is heading there already.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Don't keep her waiting. She has been working very hard, and you should be there at her side when she needs you the most.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Don't keep her waiting. She has been working very hard, and you should be there at her side when she needs you the most.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Of course... That goes for you as well.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Of course... That goes for you as well.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  Don't push yourself too hard. Rhodes Island needs you.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: Don't push yourself too hard. Rhodes Island needs you.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  I have an unexpected consultation to attend to in a moment, so I will leave it to you and Amiya to wrap things up.
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: I have an unexpected consultation to attend to in a moment, so I will leave it to you and Amiya to wrap things up.

raw: [name="Kal'tsit"]  If things go well, perhaps we will get to announce to the whole ship before sundown—
speaker: Kal'tsit
content: If things go well, perhaps we will get to announce to the whole ship before sundown—

speaker: Kal'tsit
content: —Time to set sail.
